author: Ryan Shirley
description:
Sri Lanka is one of Asia’s best travel destinations. I just returned from exploring Sri Lanka and I want to share with you my favorite places, so here is my Sri Lanka Travel Guide. From the ancient fortress of Sigiriya, to the river elephants of Pinnawala, Sri Lanka has so much to offer. Where is your favorite place in Sri Lanka?

Special thanks to our guide Harsha for taking us around Sri Lanka. You can book a tour with him - https://share.google/WSjEk7U1PI0YPVEw1
